name: @activepieces/piece-granola
description: AI-powered meeting notes — automatically captures and summarizes your meetings.

auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Open the **Granola desktop app**.
2. Go to **Settings > API**.
3. Click **Create API Key**.
4. Copy the key and paste it here.

**Note:** You need a Business or Enterprise plan to use API keys.

list_notes.name: list_notes
list_notes.description: List your meeting notes with optional date filters.

created_after.description: Only return notes created after this date. Leave empty to return all notes.

created_before.description: Only return notes created before this date. Leave empty for no upper limit.

updated_after.description: Only return notes updated after this date. Useful to find recently modified notes.

page_size.description: Number of notes to return per page (1–30).

aiMetadata.description: Lists the authenticated user's Granola meeting notes, returning a page of note summaries. With no date filters it returns the most recent notes; supply created-after/created-before/updated-after bounds to narrow to a time window (e.g. notes modified since a given time). Use it to discover notes and their IDs before fetching details with Get Note. Page size is capped at 30. Read-only and idempotent.

get_note.name: get_note
get_note.description: Retrieve a single meeting note by its ID, with optional transcript.

note_id.description: The ID of the note to retrieve. Starts with `not_` followed by 14 characters (e.g. `not_1d3tmYTlCICgjy`). You can get this from the **List Notes** action.

include_transcript.description: Include the full meeting transcript in the response. The transcript shows who said what and when.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches one Granola meeting note by its note ID, including title, owner, calendar/attendee details, and AI summary. Enable the include-transcript option to also return the full speaker-by-speaker meeting transcript. Use it after List Notes (or a note trigger) to read a specific note in depth. Requires a valid note ID (format `not_` followed by 14 characters). Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Open the **Granola desktop app**.
2. Go to **Settings > API**.

4. Copy the key and paste it here.

**Note:** You need a Business or Enterprise plan to use API keys.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_note.name: new_note
new_note.description: Triggers when a new meeting note is created in Granola.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new meeting note is created in the authenticated user's Granola account, emitting the newly captured note with its summary and meeting metadata. Detected by polling notes ordered by creation time; use it to react to freshly recorded meetings.

sampleData.title: Quarterly budget review
sampleData.summary_text: Discussed Q1 budget allocation and projections.

updated_note.name: updated_note
updated_note.description: Triggers when an existing meeting note is updated in Granola (e.g. summary edited, attendees changed).

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an already-existing Granola meeting note is modified (for example its summary is edited or attendees change), emitting the updated note. Detected by polling for notes whose updated time differs from their creation time, so brand-new notes do not fire this; use New Note for those.

sampleData.summary_text: Discussed Q1 budget allocation and projections.

nl.AI-powered meeting notes — automatically: AI-powered meeting notes - automatisch capturen en somt uw vergaderingen samen.
nl.To get your API key:\n1. Open the **Gran:
Om uw API-sleutel te verkrijgen:
1. Open de **Granola desktop app**.
2. Ga naar **Instellingen > API**.
3. Klik **Creëer API-sleutel**.
4. Kopieer en plak de sleutel hier.

**Opmerking:** U heeft een bedrijfs- of Enterprise-plan nodig om API-sleutels te gebruiken.
nl.List your meeting notes with optional da: Laat je meetingnotities zien met optionele datumfilters.
nl.Retrieve a single meeting note by its ID: Haal een enkele meetingnotitie op via de ID, met optioneel transcript.
nl.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Maak een aangepaste API call naar een specifiek eindpunt
nl.Only return notes created after this dat: Retourneer enkel notities aangemaakt na deze datum. Laat leeg om alle notities terug te geven.
nl.Only return notes created before this da: Alleen retour notities gemaakt voor deze datum. Laat leeg voor geen limiet
nl.Only return notes updated after this dat: Alleen retourneringen bijgewerkt na deze datum. Handig om recent gewijzigde notities te vinden.
nl.The ID of the note to retrieve. Starts w: Het ID van de notitie om op te halen. Begint met `not_` gevolgd door 14 tekens (bijv. `not_1d3tmYTlCICgjy`). U kunt dit krijgen vanuit de **Lijst Notes** actie.
nl.Include the full meeting transcript in t: Neem het volledige afschrift van de vergadering op in het antwoord. De transcript toont wie wat heeft gezegd en wanneer.
nl.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisatie headers worden automatisch geïnjecteerd vanuit uw verbinding.
Inschakelen voor bestanden zoals PDF's, afbeeldingen etc.
nl.HEAD: HOOFD
nl.Triggers when a new meeting note is crea: Triggeren wanneer een nieuwe vergadernotitie wordt gemaakt in Granola.
nl.Triggers when an existing meeting note i: Triggert wanneer een bestaande vergadernotitie wordt bijgewerkt in Granola (bv. samenvatting, bewerkt, deelnemers veranderd).

de.AI-powered meeting notes — automatically: AI-gestützte Meetingnotizen — erfasst und fasst Ihre Meetings automatisch zusammen.
de.To get your API key:\n1. Open the **Gran:
Um Ihren API-Schlüssel zu erhalten:
1. Öffnen Sie die **Granola Desktop-App.
2. Gehen Sie zu **Einstellungen > API**.
3. Klicken Sie auf **API-Schlüssel erstellen**.
4. Kopieren Sie den Schlüssel und fügen Sie ihn hier ein.

**Notiz:** Sie benötigen einen Business- oder Enterprise-Plan, um API-Schlüssel zu verwenden.
de.List your meeting notes with optional da: Liste deine Meetingnotizen mit optionalen Datumsfiltern.
de.Retrieve a single meeting note by its ID: Rufen Sie eine einzelne Sitzungsnotiz mit optionalem Transkript ab.
de.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Einen benutzerdefinierten API-Aufruf an einen bestimmten Endpunkt machen
de.Only return notes created after this dat: Gibt nur Notizen zurück, die nach diesem Datum erstellt wurden. Lassen Sie leer, um alle Notizen zurückzugeben.
de.Only return notes created before this da: Gibt nur Notizen zurück, die vor diesem Datum erstellt wurden. Leer lassen für keine Obergrenze.
de.Only return notes updated after this dat: Gibt nur Notizen zurück, die nach diesem Datum aktualisiert wurden. Nützlich, um kürzlich geänderte Notizen zu finden.
de.The ID of the note to retrieve. Starts w: Die ID der abzufragenden Notiz. Beginnt mit `not_` gefolgt von 14 Zeichen (z.B. `not_1d3tmYTlCICgjy`). Du kannst dies von der Aktion **Listennotizen** erhalten.
de.Include the full meeting transcript in t: Fügen Sie das vollständige Sitzungsprotokoll in die Antwort ein. Das Transkript zeigt, wer was und wann gesagt hat.
de.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisierungs-Header werden automatisch von Ihrer Verbindung injiziert.
Aktivieren für Dateien wie PDFs, Bilder usw.
de.HEAD: HEAD
de.Triggers when a new meeting note is crea: Wird ausgelöst, wenn in Granola ein neuer Meeting-Hinweis erstellt wird.
de.Triggers when an existing meeting note i: Trigger wenn eine bestehende Meetingnotiz in Granola aktualisiert wird (z.B. Zusammenfassung bearbeitet, Teilnehmer geändert).

pt.Only return notes created after this dat: Somente devolve notas criadas após esta data. Deixe em branco para devolver todas as notas.
pt.Only return notes created before this da: Somente notas de retorno criadas antes desta data. Deixe em branco para nenhum limite superior.
pt.Only return notes updated after this dat: Somente devoluções notas atualizadas após esta data. Útil para encontrar notas modificadas recentemente.
pt.Number of notes to return per page (1–30: Número de notas a retornar por página (1–30).
